I know, I know. You always said love would find me
when I stopped looking for it. It turns out it was
sitting at the bar of my guild the whole time,
He's loud. He's reckless. He climbs in through my

What I was saying. Where I was going.
I'm scared I'll forget something important. So I'm

His name is Natsu Dragneel. And I love him.
